results.title: Ras Al Khaimah Expands U.S. Business Ties With Three Letters of Intent
results.description: A Ras Al Khaimah delegation has concluded a U.S. trade and investment visit spanning Florida, Michigan, Nevada and Utah, signing three Letters of Intent and advancing discussions on trade, investment and research with U.S. businesses, universities and economic development organizations.
